sections.heading: Lionel Messi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Lionel Messi was born on 24 June 1987 in Rosario, and holds Argentine, Spanish and Italian nationality. He was given the name Lionel Andrés Messi Cuccitini at birth and is publicly known as Lionel Messi.
Public records name his mother, Celia Cuccittini.
He is recorded as speaking Spanish and Argentine Spanish.

sections.heading: Lionel Messi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Lionel Messi works primarily as an association football player, with Inter Miami CF listed among his employers.
On the team sheet, Lionel has been associated with Inter Miami CF (from 2023). He plays as a forward.
He has held the following offices: UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador (2010–present).
He has taken part in 2008 Summer Olympics, 2014 FIFA World Cup, 2010 FIFA World Cup, 2006 FIFA World Cup and 2018 FIFA World Cup.
